title: How to Cancel Midjourney — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel your Midjourney subscription and stop the monthly charge. Manage your plan through Discord or the Midjourney website.
intro: Midjourney subscriptions are managed through their website at midjourney.com/account. You keep access to your generated images after canceling, but lose the ability to create new ones.

steps.title: Go to your Midjourney account page
steps.text: Visit midjourney.com/account and sign in with your Discord account. You'll see your current plan and billing details.

steps.title: Click "Manage Sub" or find subscription settings
steps.text: Look for "Manage Sub" or "Manage Plan" button on your account page. This opens your subscription management panel.
steps.tip: You can also type /subscribe in any Midjourney Discord channel to get a link to your account page.

steps.title: Click "Cancel Plan"
steps.text: Click "Cancel Plan" in your subscription settings. Midjourney will show your current billing cycle end date.

steps.title: Confirm cancellation
steps.text: Confirm your cancellation. Your remaining image generation credits are available until the end of your billing period. After that, you can still view and download your previously generated images.
steps.tip: Use your remaining monthly credits before the period ends — they don't carry over or get refunded.

warnings: You keep access to all previously generated images in your gallery at midjourney.com — they're not deleted.
Unused generation credits for the current period are forfeited at cancellation — use them first.
If you subscribed through the yearly plan, you may not get a refund for unused months.
You retain commercial usage rights for images generated while you had a paid subscription.

faqs.q: Will I lose my Midjourney images if I cancel?
faqs.a: No. All images you generated remain in your gallery at midjourney.com and can be downloaded anytime. You just can't generate new ones.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from Midjourney?
faqs.a: Midjourney offers refunds if you've used less than 1% of your monthly GPU time (about 2-3 image generations). Contact their support through Discord for refund requests.

faqs.q: Do I keep commercial rights to my images after canceling?
faqs.a: Yes. Images generated while you had a paid subscription retain their commercial usage rights even after cancellation. Free trial images have more restrictive terms.

faqs.q: What's a free alternative to Midjourney?
faqs.a: DALL-E (limited free generations via Bing Image Creator), Stable Diffusion (free and open source, runs locally), and Leonardo AI (free tier with daily credits) are popular alternatives.

refund.details: Midjourney offers refunds if you've used less than 1% of your monthly GPU allocation. For annual plans, partial refunds may be available. Contact support through their Discord server.

retentionTactics: Midjourney doesn't use aggressive retention tactics. The cancellation is relatively straightforward.
